tools.name: fabric_list_workspaces
tools.description: List all Fabric workspaces the caller can access.

tools.name: fabric_get_workspace
tools.description: Get a workspace by ID.

tools.name: fabric_create_workspace
tools.description: Create a new workspace, optionally bound to a capacity.

tools.name: fabric_update_workspace
tools.description: Update a workspace name/description.

tools.name: fabric_delete_workspace
tools.description: Delete a workspace. Destructive.

tools.name: fabric_list_workspace_role_assignments
tools.description: List role assignments (members) on a workspace.

tools.name: fabric_add_workspace_role_assignment
tools.description: Add a member (user/group/service principal) to a workspace with a role (Admin/Member/Contributor/Viewer).

tools.name: fabric_delete_workspace_role_assignment
tools.description: Remove a role assignment from a workspace. Destructive.

tools.name: fabric_assign_workspace_to_capacity
tools.description: Assign a workspace to a capacity.

tools.name: fabric_unassign_workspace_from_capacity
tools.description: Unassign a workspace from its capacity.

tools.name: fabric_list_capacities
tools.description: List the capacities the caller can access.

tools.name: fabric_list_items
tools.description: List items in a workspace, optionally filtered by type (Lakehouse, Notebook, DataPipeline, Warehouse, SemanticModel, Report, …).

tools.name: fabric_get_item
tools.description: Get a single item by ID.

tools.name: fabric_create_item
tools.description: Create any Fabric item by type, optionally with a definition (file parts). Use the type-specific tools for richer ergonomics.

definitionParts.description: Definition file parts (encoded to InlineBase64 automatically)

tools.name: fabric_update_item
tools.description: Update an item's name/description.

tools.name: fabric_delete_item
tools.description: Delete an item by ID. Destructive.

tools.name: fabric_get_item_definition
tools.description: Fetch an item's full definition (long-running). Returns the raw definition and decoded file contents.

tools.name: fabric_update_item_definition
tools.description: Replace an item's definition from file parts (long-running).

parts.description: Definition file parts (encoded to InlineBase64 automatically)

tools.name: fabric_list_lakehouses
tools.description: List lakehouses in a workspace.

tools.name: fabric_get_lakehouse
tools.description: Get a lakehouse (includes its SQL endpoint + OneLake paths).

tools.name: fabric_create_lakehouse
tools.description: Create a lakehouse, optionally schema-enabled.

tools.name: fabric_delete_lakehouse
tools.description: Delete a lakehouse. Destructive.

tools.name: fabric_list_lakehouse_tables
tools.description: List the Delta tables in a lakehouse.

tools.name: fabric_load_lakehouse_table
tools.description: Load a file/folder in OneLake into a Delta table (long-running).

relativePath.description: Source path under the lakehouse, e.g. "Files/data/sales.csv"

pathType.description: Whether the source is a file or folder

tools.name: fabric_run_table_maintenance
tools.description: Run table maintenance (OPTIMIZE / V-Order / VACUUM) on a lakehouse table (long-running).

tools.name: fabric_list_warehouses
tools.description: List warehouses in a workspace.

tools.name: fabric_get_warehouse
tools.description: Get a warehouse (includes its SQL connection string).

tools.name: fabric_create_warehouse
tools.description: Create a data warehouse.

tools.name: fabric_delete_warehouse
tools.description: Delete a warehouse. Destructive.

tools.name: fabric_list_sql_endpoints
tools.description: List SQL analytics endpoints in a workspace.

tools.name: fabric_get_sql_endpoint
tools.description: Get a SQL analytics endpoint (connection string, etc.).

tools.name: fabric_refresh_sql_endpoint_metadata
tools.description: Sync a SQL analytics endpoint's metadata with its source lakehouse (long-running).

tools.name: fabric_list_shortcuts
tools.description: List OneLake shortcuts on an item (e.g. a lakehouse).

itemId.description: Item ID that hosts the shortcut (e.g. a lakehouse)

tools.name: fabric_get_shortcut
tools.description: Get a single OneLake shortcut by path + name.

itemId.description: Item ID that hosts the shortcut (e.g. a lakehouse)

tools.name: fabric_create_shortcut
tools.description: Create a OneLake shortcut. `target` is the source definition, e.g. {"oneLake":{"workspaceId":"...","itemId":"...","path":"Tables/x"}} or {"adlsGen2":{...}} / {"amazonS3":{...}}.

itemId.description: Item ID that hosts the shortcut (e.g. a lakehouse)

path.description: Where to create the shortcut, e.g. "Files" or "Tables"

tools.name: fabric_delete_shortcut
tools.description: Delete a OneLake shortcut by path + name. Destructive.

itemId.description: Item ID that hosts the shortcut (e.g. a lakehouse)

tools.name: fabric_list_notebooks
tools.description: List notebooks in a workspace.

tools.name: fabric_get_notebook
tools.description: Get a notebook by ID.

tools.name: fabric_create_notebook
tools.description: Create a notebook. Optionally populate cells at creation and attach a default lakehouse.

defaultLakehouse.description: Attach a default lakehouse so unqualified spark.sql() table names resolve

tools.name: fabric_update_notebook_definition
tools.description: Replace a notebook's cells (long-running). Optionally attach a default lakehouse.

defaultLakehouse.description: Attach a default lakehouse so unqualified spark.sql() table names resolve

tools.name: fabric_get_notebook_definition
tools.description: Fetch a notebook's definition and decoded cell source (long-running).

tools.name: fabric_run_notebook
tools.description: Run a notebook on demand. Optionally pass executionData (parameters, configuration).

tools.name: fabric_list_pipelines
tools.description: List data pipelines in a workspace.

tools.name: fabric_get_pipeline
tools.description: Get a data pipeline by ID.

tools.name: fabric_create_pipeline
tools.description: Create a data pipeline, optionally with activities + parameters.

tools.name: fabric_update_pipeline_definition
tools.description: Replace a pipeline's activities + parameters (long-running).

tools.name: fabric_get_pipeline_definition
tools.description: Fetch a pipeline's definition (activities/parameters) decoded (long-running).

tools.name: fabric_run_pipeline
tools.description: Run a data pipeline on demand. Optionally pass executionData (parameters).

tools.name: fabric_run_job
tools.description: Run an on-demand job for any item, by job type. Optionally pass executionData.

itemId.description: Item ID (notebook, pipeline, spark job definition, lakehouse, …)

tools.name: fabric_list_job_instances
tools.description: List job instances (runs) for an item.

itemId.description: Item ID (notebook, pipeline, spark job definition, lakehouse, …)

tools.name: fabric_get_job_instance
tools.description: Get the status/details of a job instance.

itemId.description: Item ID (notebook, pipeline, spark job definition, lakehouse, …)

tools.name: fabric_cancel_job
tools.description: Cancel a running job instance.

itemId.description: Item ID (notebook, pipeline, spark job definition, lakehouse, …)

tools.name: fabric_list_job_schedules
tools.description: List schedules configured for an item's job type.

itemId.description: Item ID (notebook, pipeline, spark job definition, lakehouse, …)

tools.name: fabric_create_job_schedule
tools.description: Create a schedule for an item's job. configuration is the Fabric schedule object, e.g. {"type":"Daily","startDateTime":"2026-01-01T00:00:00","times":["09:00"],"localTimeZoneId":"UTC"}.

itemId.description: Item ID (notebook, pipeline, spark job definition, lakehouse, …)
